title: Mossworks Labs PR Validation Config
description: Per-repo configuration for the org's universal PR-validation workflow. Drop this file at .github/pr_validation.yml in any repo. The reusable workflow at Mossworks-Labs/.github/.github/workflows/pr.yml reads it on every PR.

checks.description: Toggle individual checks. Standard Node/TS checks default to true; optional checks default to false.

scripts.description: Override npm script names. Defaults match the keys in `checks` (e.g. `lint`, `typecheck`, `format:check`, `build`, `test`).

docker.description: Docker build matrix. Each entry produces one `PR / Docker (<name>)` job that runs `docker build --push=false`. Sensitive build-time tokens belong in the trampoline's `build-secrets` (BuildKit secrets), not here.

dockerfile.description: Dockerfile path relative to the repo root.

build-args.description: Newline-separated KEY=VALUE pairs. Public, non-sensitive only — secrets go in `build-secrets` at the trampoline.

helm.description: Helm chart-testing options. The job runs `ct list-changed`, `ct lint`, then `helm template` on each changed chart.

charts-dir.description: Directory containing the charts (relative to repo root).

pulumi.description: Pulumi preview options. Requires `PULUMI_ACCESS_TOKEN` secret on the trampoline.
